title: Staff Software Engineer - Data Platform
description: P-375 Staff Software Engineer (L6) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Data Platform team builds the Data Intelligence Platform that powers decision-making across Databricks. Working at the intersection of data infrastructure and AI, you will design systems that manage business and product metrics at scale, develop tooling to operate Databricks on Databricks across multiple clouds and geographies, and partner with engineering teams to shape the long-term vision of the Databricks product. The Impact You Will Have - Design and operate the cross-company Data Intelligence Platform, balancing data protection with accessibility as the company scales - Build tooling and infrastructure to efficiently manage and run Databricks on Databricks at scale across multiple clouds, geographies, and deployment types - Develop CI/CD processes, test frameworks for pipelines and data quality, and infrastructure-as-code tooling - Partner with engineering teams to provide technical leadership and define long-term product requirements - Build reliable data pipelines using Databricks, partner products, and open-source tools, providing early feedback on design and operations - Represent Databricks at academic and industrial conferences and events What We Look For - 8+ years of software engineering experience - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments - Experience leading architecture efforts for performance-sensitive systems including latency-critical services, multi-tenant platforms, or large-scale data pipelines - Experience providing technical leadership on production data systems at scale - Strong communication skills and ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, cross-functional environments - Strategic mindset with ability to align engineering execution with longer-term product and company goals - Passion for mentoring and developing other engineers - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
